name: itpr
description: Skills and subagents that take a ticket from diagnosis to a reviewed PR: adversarial review, test authoring, PR lifecycle, and the pipeline that chains them

plugins.name: adversarial-review
plugins.description: Adversarial review skills: review-issue-fact (issue), review-plan-risk (design), review-code-risk (implementation)

plugins.name: pr-lifecycle
plugins.description: Team-agnostic PR lifecycle skills (Azure DevOps or GitHub): open-pr, resolve-pr-comments

plugins.name: test-authoring
plugins.description: Test authoring plugin: scan-test-gaps, add/update test workflows, setup-test-context

plugins.name: issue-to-pr-pipeline
plugins.description: Issue-to-PR orchestration: resolve-issue chains the review, test, and PR-lifecycle skills into one resumable pipeline behind a single plan-approval gate; resolve-issue-dashboard is a read-only dashboard that visualises a run
